input.quote: 13.5 No Other Warranties. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY STATED IN THIS ARTICLE XIII, (A) NO REPRESENTATION, CONDITION OR WARRANTY WHATSOEVER IS MADE OR GIVEN BY OR ON BEHALF OF SANOFI OR REVMED; AND (B) ALL OTHER CONDITIONS AND WARRANTIES WHETHER WRITTEN OR ORAL OR EXPRESS OR IMPLIED ARE HEREBY EXPRESSLY EXCLUDED, INCLUDING ANY CONDITIONS AND WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE OR NON-INFRINGEMENT.
input.rationale: Article XIII contains only title/IP-style representations given as of the Execution Date (13.1, 13.2) and covenants (13.3, 13.4); nowhere in the Agreement is there a performance warranty for RevMed's work — no conformance warranty for any software or deliverable, no warranted period for RevMed's services, and no repair/replacement or refund remedy (searches for "software", "Deliverable" and workmanlike/performance standards return nothing). Section 13.5 then disclaims everything not expressly stated in Article XIII, so the gap is affirmative rather than merely silent, which fails every fallback element. We therefore insert the shortest fallback warranty as new Section 13.3(e) — 90-day software-to-documentation conformance, 30-day services conformance, with repair/replacement or refund — placed inside Article XIII so the 13.5 carve-out preserves it. We did not pursue the preferred 12-month/no-malicious-code package; compliance with Applicable Law is already covered by the mutual covenant in Section 13.4(b).

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.summary: Insert a RevMed performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services) with repair/replacement and refund remedies as new Section 13.3(e).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XIII gives no performance warranty for RevMed's work and Section 13.5 disclaims all warranties not expressly stated in the Article, so we added our fallback warranty: 90-day software-to-documentation conformance, a 30-day services warranty, and repair/replacement or refund as the remedy.

ops.text: RevMed warrants that (i) any software delivered by RevMed to Sanofi under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to its documentation for ninety (90) days following delivery, and (ii) the services RevMed performs under this Agreement will conform in all material respects to the applicable Research Plan or Development Plan for thirty (30) days following performance. For breach of this warranty, RevMed will repair or replace the non-conforming software, re-perform the non-conforming services, or refund the amounts paid for the non-conforming software or services.
